title: Properties of materials
misconception: 1B-M2: thinks a bigger piece has different properties
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: A property tells you what a material is like.
A material may be strong, or light, or waterproof.
A football bounces because rubber is springy.
A plastic bowl at the market holds water. Plastic is waterproof.
A glass bottle lets you see inside. Glass is see-through. We say transparent.
A small piece of glass and a big piece of glass have the same properties.
The property belongs to the material, not to the size of the object.
Now it is your turn. Name a property of a material you know.
